items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-cohomological-descent-etale-fppf at source lines 1218-1229: for K in D^+(X_etale) - with no torsion hypothesis, unlike the ph statement - the maps pi_X^{-1}K -> R epsilon_{X,*}a_X^{-1}K and K -> R a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}K are isomorphisms. The author's proof at source lines 1231-1259 proves the second statement only (noting the first is easier and identical in method), reduces from a bounded below complex to a single abelian sheaf by the sheaf case degreewise together with Leray's acyclicity lemma (a cross-chapter pointer), and then proves the sheaf case from the two parts of the chapter's fppf comparison lemma (retained as context), the relative Leray spectral sequence for a_X = epsilon_X o pi_X (a second pointer), the vanishing of the higher direct images of epsilon_{X,*} on a_X^{-1}F, and the vanishing of R^j pi_{X,*} on pi_X^{-1}F supplied by the chapter's descent lemma (also retained as context). The counted argument is a complete two-stage reduction whose in-chapter ingredients are available inside the package.
